title: Gewerbsmäßiger Computerbetrug und Diebstahl – Wer erkennt den Tatverdächtigen?

extraction.summaryEn: Police appeal for information about an unknown suspect who allegedly stole mailed bank cards and PINs and withdrew money between August and September 2024 in nine computer fraud cases and three thefts. The suspect used a cash machine at Leipziger Platz 12.
